BiblicalUsage: Twice, and both times as a father's name: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai. And the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, and the name is the father's name, and the son is the captain of the camp of Dan on the north side.
TheologicalSignificance: Every captain is named by his father, and that is all this name does: it places Ahiezer in the camp of Dan, on the north side, under his father's name.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
